How to Start Running When You Are Out of Shape: Beginner Guide

By Coach Emily Parker | Updated October 2026

What is the best way for you to start running?

The best way you can start running is using the run-walk method. You alternate between one minute of gentle jogging and two minutes of brisk walking. Doing this three times a week builds your stamina without stressing your joints.

How fast should you run on your first week?

You should run at a conversational pace where you can easily speak full sentences out loud without gasping for breath. If you cannot speak comfortably, you should slow down immediately.

What gear do you really need?

  • You need properly fitted running shoes from a specialty running store.
  • You need moisture-wicking socks to prevent painful blisters.
  • You need a basic water bottle for hydration on warm days.

Your 4-Week Beginner Plan

  1. Week 1: Walk 4 minutes, jog 1 minute, repeat 5 times.
  2. Week 2: Walk 3 minutes, jog 2 minutes, repeat 5 times.
  3. Week 3: Walk 2 minutes, jog 3 minutes, repeat 5 times.
  4. Week 4: Walk 1 minute, jog 4 minutes, repeat 5 times.
